Supports receive source and edited images. Answer only the saved proposition using its binding and criteria. Use pass/fail/unknown. Context is advisory unless listed in required_dependencies. Supporting passes answer specific propositions, not a count of completed edits. Their polarity can differ. Apply saved alternatives: optional uncertainty need not prevent a known outcome, but a required unresolved fact makes that outcome unresolved.
